ns0:svg.ns0:title: B09 four-state fuel projections at lambda 0.0
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Coordinate projections of the saved four-state terminal V rows, with open-loop and receding-horizon nonlinear replay endpoints marked separately. The V rows are plotted as points; no projected hull is recomputed. Equal data scaling is used within each same-unit coordinate pair. Numeric ticks and major gridlines follow csl-report-quantitative-v1.
